Total Q3 spend was $412,600 against a budget of $398,000, an overrun of $14,600 (3.7%).

screen:
From: Martin Hale
Subject: Q3 numbers before Thursday?
Hi, could you send me a short summary of where operations landed for Q3 before the leadership meeting on Thursday? Just the headline figures and what we plan to do about any overrun.
Thanks, Martin
text:
Hi Martin,

Here is the short version. Total Q3 spend was $412,600 against a budget of $398,000, so we are over by $14,600, or 3.7%. Most of that came from contractors, who cost $68,900 against a budget of $52,000, because the warehouse migration ran three weeks longer than planned. Equipment was also over at $43,800, while travel came in under at $11,200.

Finance recommends freezing new contractor engagements until the migration is signed off, moving the equipment refresh for the Leeds office into Q1, and keeping the travel underspend as a buffer for Q4.

Happy to go through the detail before Thursday.

Best,
Sam

Reset two-factor authentication
Updated 2 weeks ago
If you lost access to your authenticator app, you can reset two-factor authentication from the sign-in page.
1. On the sign-in page, enter your email and password, then choose "Use a recovery code".
2. Enter one of the ten recovery codes you saved when you turned on two-factor authentication.
3. Go to Settings > Security and choose "Reset authenticator".

Kind regards,
Support team

context:
Lemon Ricotta Pancakes
Serves 4. Prep 10 minutes, cook 20 minutes.
Ingredients
250 g ricotta
3 eggs, separated
180 ml milk
150 g plain flour
2 tbsp caster sugar
1 tsp baking powder
Zest of 2 lemons
Butter for the pan
Method
Whisk the ricotta, egg yolks, milk and lemon zest. Fold in the flour, sugar and baking powder. Beat the egg whites to soft peaks and fold them in gently. Cook spoonfuls in a buttered pan over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side.

context_title: Four-day week trial ends with most firms staying on - Northfield Herald
context:
Four-day week trial ends with most firms staying on
By the Herald business desk
Sixty-one companies took part in the six-month trial, which ended in December. Of those, 56 say they will continue with a four-day week, and 18 have made the change permanent. Revenue stayed broadly the same over the trial, rising 1.4% on average. The number of staff leaving fell by 57% compared with the same period a year earlier, and sick days fell by 65%. Researchers said the biggest change was in how meetings were run: most firms cut standing meetings to 30 minutes and moved status updates to written notes.

context:
Lecture 6: How memory works
Working memory holds about four items at a time.
Information fades from working memory within 15 to 30 seconds unless it is rehearsed.
Spaced repetition: reviewing after 1 day, 3 days and 7 days beats one long session.
The testing effect: practising recall strengthens memory more than rereading.
Sleep helps consolidate new memories, especially in the first night after learning.
Reading for next week: chapter 7, pages 141 to 168.
